name: Power supplies and adapters
summary: Mains power supplies and adapters: wall warts, laptop bricks, ATX and LED supplies.
uses: Powering 5, 12, 19 or 24V gear from a generator or inverter
Bench supply for testing and charging
Spare adapters for radios and routers
identify: Wall plugs and bricks in every drawer, metal-cased LED supplies in signs and shop lighting, ATX supplies in desktop PCs, and open boards in printers and TVs. The label gives input and output volts and amps. Big capacitors inside stay charged after unplugging.
test: Plug in and measure the output: within about 5% of the label is good. An ATX supply starts when its green wire is joined to a black one.
